elements.requirement: The Act may be cited as the Bail Act 1976.
elements.quote: This act may be cited as the Bail Act 1976.

elements.requirement: The Bail Act 1976, with the exception of section 13, shall come into force on such day as the Secretary of State may appoint by order in a statutory instrument.
elements.quote: This Act (except this section) shall come into force on such day as the Secretary of State may by order in a statutory instrument appoint.

elements.requirement: Section 1 of the Bail Act 1976 applies to bail grantable by the Court Martial Appeal Court when that court is sitting outside England and Wales.
elements.quote: Section 1 of this Act applies to bail grantable by the Court Martial Appeal Court when sitting outside England and Wales

elements.requirement: Section 6 of the Bail Act 1976 applies to a failure outside England and Wales to surrender to custody by a person who was granted bail by the Court Martial Appeal Court.
elements.quote: section 6 of this Act applies to a failure outside England and Wales by a person granted bail by that Court to surrender to custody.

elements.requirement: The Bail Act 1976 does not extend beyond England and Wales, except as provided by section 13(3), except for so much of section 8 as relates to entering into recognizances in Scotland, and except for paragraphs 31 and 46 of Schedule 2.
elements.quote: Except as provided by subsection (3) above and with the exception of so much of section 8 as relates to entering into recognizances in Scotland and paragraphs 31 and 46 of Schedule 2 to this Act, this Act does not extend beyond England and Wales.
